'''Digby''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Digby worked as a storeman at [[Hedrett Public Transport Facility]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hedrett]]. He often supplemented his income by stealing various things from the port. However, when he tried to steal some cargo that the [[Heroes of Cularin]] had been hired to collect, they attempted to apprehend him.
